title: Cross-tenant support role: a granted support principal reads tenant-b; the same principal's request operating on tenant-a while referencing tenant-b resources is denied by tenant isolation
note: Permission intent is DECLARED by the fixture author: the operator grants the support role per tenant (capability grants) and the request carries an authoritative tenant. The legitimate leg is a support read of the tenant the request operates on; the violating twin operates on tenant-a while its arguments reference tenant-b resources — the tenant isolation rule denies it (rule id embeds the principal hash). Grants exist for BOTH tenants, so the deny is attributable to isolation, not to a missing grant. Effects: the probe asserts decisions only; real-execution counterparts for allow decisions are pinned by the agent-level cases.
